core_question: How do I fix a tent that's leaking or no longer waterproof? (secondary: How do I stop my car's battery from going dead while the car isn't being driven?)
answer_summary: Clean and dry the tent, apply seam sealer to leaking stitched seams, and reapply a durable water repellent (DWR) coating to the fly and floor fabric to restore water resistance.; after the topic shift: Hook up a trickle charger or automatic battery maintainer to the battery terminals to keep it topped off during extended periods of disuse.
persona: skeptical and testy; using casual slang
